name: Tier A dr-worker raw-JSONL evidence ledger via Write + cite-key aspect report (no worker shell)
purpose: dr-worker has no Bash: it must write reports/<TOPIC>/evidence/<ASPECT>.jsonl through the Write tool (worker-protocol rule 8) and cite with [@key] markers (no bibliography); the orchestrator's merge must validate the ledger and render must resolve every marker. Companion to agent-test/deep-research-q04-evidence-ledger for the Claude Code plugin Tier A path.
prompt: no-interview light-research: Using the bioresearcher-deep-research plugin skill, briefly map the CURRENT clinical-trial landscape (Phase 2/3, recruiting or active) and the key recent publications for PARP inhibitor maintenance therapy in ovarian cancer. The report must cite at least one clinical trial (NCT id) and at least one article (PMID).

checks.flag: ledger-discipline: open reports/**/evidence/*.jsonl and spot-check 2-3 records: fields copied verbatim from tool output (titles not paraphrased, locator fields present or null - not invented), provenance entries carry the aspect, and every [@key] cite-key marker in the aspect report resolves to a ledger record (no invented keys; pmid:/doi:/nct: shapes). The aspect report must contain NO hand-numbered [N] citations and NO bibliography section (deep-research 1.5.0 contract). The final report's References must include at least one NCT trial entry alongside article entries (two-source requirement). Record whether the orchestrator ran the Step 5 pipeline (merge -> verify -> render -> vet - look for the [evidence-ledger] render: banner in the transcripts) or the sequential Tier C inline path was taken.
